name: Pomodoro
tagline: Focus timer with work/break cycles for Even G2.
description: Pomodoro technique timer for Even G2. Work sessions with short breaks and a long break after every set: 25, 5 and 15 minutes by default, adjustable on the phone. Tap to start or pause; tap then hold for Skip and Reset. When a phase ends the status line blinks and the timer counts the extra time until you start the next phase, and your session is kept if the app is closed.
author: Marcelo
